Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Monday
Markets.summary: Indian equities dropped more than 2% last week due to rising crude oil prices, foreign institutional investor outflows, and geopolitical tensions. Market breadth heavily favored bears as broader domestic markets and global indices also declined.

Markets.title: Peter Lynch on stock picking: 'You shouldn't own a stock if you can't…'
Markets.summary: Legendary investor Peter Lynch advises that people should thoroughly understand a company before buying its stock. He stresses that investors must research business fundamentals, growth prospects, and financials instead of relying on popularity or hearsay.

Markets.title: Mcap of 8 of top-10 firms erodes by Rs 1.55 lakh cr; HDFC Bank, Bajaj Fin biggest laggards
Markets.summary: Eight of India's top ten firms lost Rs 1.55 lakh crore in market valuation amid a bearish stock market. HDFC Bank and Bajaj Finance suffered the largest losses while the BSE Sensex plummeted by 1,605.44 points.

Markets.title: F&O Talk: Nifty plunged 2% this week. Are charts indicating a deeper sell-off?
Markets.summary: SBI Securities analyst Sudeep Shah expects Indian equities to remain weak due to negative FII positioning, rising volatility, and technical indicators. He notes that the Nifty could face further selling pressure and identifies key support and resistance levels while highlighting the IT sector as relatively strong.

Markets.title: Warren Buffett’s 6 golden rules for investors after retirement
Markets.summary: Warren Buffett advises retirees to focus on low-cost index investing, paying off high-interest debt, and maintaining cash reserves. His financial strategy also emphasizes staying within one's circle of competence and living frugally to manage risk.

Markets.title: 11 Penny stocks surged up to 180% in 3 months. Do you own any?
Markets.summary: Eleven small-cap penny stocks priced under Rs 20 surged up to 181% over a three-month period. Kapil Raj Finance and Tuni Textile Mills led the gains among these low-priced equities, according to ACE Equity data.

Geo-Political.title: Musk says SpaceX restricted Ukraine's Starlink connection as service restored
Geo-Political.summary: SpaceX restricted Ukraine's access to the Starlink satellite network because the company accused the country of violating terms of service through military use. The Starlink service has since been restored.

Geo-Political.title: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado returns after months in exile
Geo-Political.summary: Venezuelan opposition leader María Machado has returned to the country following months in exile. Her return comes a month after the United States government seized Venezuelan President Nicolás Maduro.

Geo-Political.title: Early reports suggest record high turnout in Serbia elections
Geo-Political.summary: Serbians are voting in an election with early reports indicating record high turnout. A student movement is attempting to remove longtime populist leader Aleksandar Vučić from power.

Geo-Political.summary: The suspect in a deadly Paris suburb shooting has been sent for psychiatric observation. Authorities are evaluating his mental health to determine if he is fit to continue interrogation.

Geo-Political.summary: The Israeli Defense Forces are closing West Bank crossings and restricting Palestinian workers ahead of Tuesday's election. This action is part of an escalating crackdown on the movement of Palestinians.

Data & Insights.title: Centre extends AIF scheme to boost farm infrastructure investments
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government has extended the Agriculture Infrastructure Fund until March 31, 2027. The scheme provides subsidized loans and credit guarantees to build facilities like warehouses and cold storages to reduce crop losses.

Data & Insights.summary: This week's key financial events include the release of the Indian government's first-half fiscal data and factory output figures. Investors will also closely monitor Hindustan Unilever's (HUL) second-quarter earnings report.

Data & Insights.title: France’s debt crisis explained: Could it trigger another euro zone meltdown?
Data & Insights.summary: France's declining economic activity and rising borrowing risks are worsening its public finances and business confidence. These financial struggles and ongoing protests are raising concerns about a potential economic meltdown across the entire euro zone.

Data & Insights.title: 500 GW by 2030: Experts explain why India needs to power up battery storage capacity and grid infra to meet the target
Data & Insights.summary: Experts state that India must modernize its power grid and expand battery storage to reach its 2030 target of 500 GW of non-fossil fuel capacity. As of July 31, 2026, the country has installed 300.50 GW of this capacity.

Data & Insights.title: India’s commerce and industry ministry working to identify AI proof sectors: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: India's commerce and industry ministry is working to identify economic sectors that can withstand artificial intelligence-led disruptions. Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal announced this initiative to prepare the country's workforce and industries for technological changes.

Data & Insights.title: Rishikesh–Karnaprayag rail line to have 16 tunnels: How India’s homegrown technology is advancing Himalayan connectivity
Data & Insights.summary: India is advancing construction on the 125-kilometer Rishikesh–Karnaprayag railway line, which will feature 16 tunnels. This project highlights the expansion of India's domestic tunnel boring machine manufacturing capabilities to improve Himalayan connectivity.

India.title: 17 Men Claiming To Be Kuki Cadres Arrested, Arms Seized In Manipur
India.summary: Security forces in Manipur arrested 17 men claiming to be Kuki cadres. Authorities seized 24 firearms, 38 magazines, ammunition, explosives, wireless communication equipment, and combat gear during the operation.
